# SMS reminder provider: Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by the weekly sync attendees.

## Decision
SMS reminder provider is **Sinch**, effective 2026-11-01 for pilot clinics.

## Why
Vonage delivery is failing on Portuguese numbers and is not meeting reliability expectations.

This replaces [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage]], which is no longer current.

## Context
See the weekly sync notes for 2026-10-13. Priya will redesign SMS templates for the new provider.

# Release cadence: twice-weekly releases on Tuesdays and Thursdays

Decided on 2026-10-15 by [[Daniel Reyes]] and [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **twice-weekly releases**, on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with changes still deployed behind feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics; a regular cadence reduces disruption while keeping feature flags for control.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags]] and [[Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday]], which are no longer current.

## Context
Team will update billing/docs and customer comms to reflect the new cadence.

Decided on 2026-10-14 by [[Tom Lindqvist]] and [[Maya Okafor]].

## Decision
Product analytics vendor is **PostHog Cloud (EU region)**.

Self-hosting PostHog is consuming excessive ops time; switching to PostHog Cloud keeps clinic data in the EU while reducing operational burden.

## Context
Task owners will update billing and docs and roll out the cloud-hosted analytics for pilot clinics.

# Weekly sync, 2026-10-13

Attendees: [[Maya Okafor]], [[Tom Lindqvist]], [[Priya Raman]], [[Daniel Reyes]], [[Sofia Marchetti]], [[Kenji Watanabe]]

- Launch recap: we launched publicly on 6 October as planned. Early feedback from clinics is good.
- SMS reminders: Vonage keeps failing on Portuguese numbers too. Agreed: we move SMS reminders to Sinch from 1 November. Vonage is out.
- Kenji to stop the Vonage rollout; that task is no longer needed.
- Action: Priya to redesign the SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 30 October.
- Support tool: Sofia floated moving from Plain to Zendesk. Not decided; Maya wants to see Plain's new pricing first. Revisit in December.
- Several receptionists asked again for per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

## Actions
- [[Priya Raman]] — redesign SMS reminder templates for Sinch (due 2026-10-30).
- [[Kenji Watanabe]] — stop Vonage rollout (Vonage rollout cancelled; see tasks).
- [[Maya Okafor]] — review Plain pricing and revisit support tool decision in December.
